Crowsnest is the best place to view college sailing scores.

The best place to view college sailing scores and stats. This ongoing project has been great experience for building and deploying a production level full stack application. Over 1.3k unique visitors and 40k page views with an average session duration of over 7 minutes.

This project handles the backend infrastructure of the crowsnest data. Contains a parallel webscraper that collects the latest scores from the official source. Then runs data processing and calculates ratings of every sailor based on the updated races. Finally uploads the new data in an optimized format for storage in the database.

A school project practicing object oriented design and good programming practices. Simulates flocking behaviours of animals in nature. Based on a Mike Reynolds algorithm from the 80s. Ported to the web soon after creation.
A project that combined hardware and software to independently control multiple led strips through a web interface.

A 3d game environment commissioned for krunker.io. Set in a secret research facility in the depths of the ocean, this map was unique in its aesthetic as well as its level design. It played with verticality in a way not executed in previous maps for this game.

A commissioned project for deadshot.io. Set in an old mining town in the far reaches of Alaska, this map has well balanced gameplay and a high level of detail. A collaboration with fellow artist Octodoodle, it features many unique areas including a mineshaft, sawmill, sleeping quarters, and many buildings throughout the town. The project is well optimized, and required many skills to create such as terrain creation, modeling, texturing, and general knowledge of level design and environment art.
